title: On Bearing the noise for another night
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：bear　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bear 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1978 the keeper ① bore the noise for another night without a word of thanks, and every traveller in the tower said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the keeper ② bears the noise for another night at once without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ bear the noise for another night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ borne the noise for another night before — a line in the calendar for January 1972 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Bearing the noise for another night without a word of thanks, the keeper said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the clock at the far stair, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ bear the whole cost without complaint at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Bear the whole cost without complaint at once and never mention it again.

By 1985 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the calendar, and a new traveller from the next tower ⑧ bears the whole cost without complaint without a word of thanks every year without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stair, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ bore the noise for another night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To bear the noise for another night, my mother said in 1990, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the tower remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the tower forgets, somebody bears the noise for another night at once again and somebody must bear the noise for another night without a word of thanks all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 忍受（一般过去式 bore the noise for another night：1978 年守夜人头一回这样做，不图一句谢）
B. v. 忍受（一般现在 bears the noise for another night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 忍受（不定式 to bear the noise for another night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 忍受（过去完成时 had borne the noise for another night：1972 年一月的年历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 忍受（动名词 bearing the noise for another night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 承担（bear the whole cost without complaint：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去承担毫无怨言地担下整笔费用）
G. v. 承担（bear the whole cost without complaint：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 忍受（后段两处：新来的过路人照例 bears the whole cost without complaint，而母亲又一次 bore the noise for another night）

answers.why: bear 意为“忍受”，1978 年守夜人不图一句谢忍受再忍一夜的那种吵，那是钟楼里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 bore。
bear 意为“忍受”，自那以后守夜人二话不说地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 bears。
bear 意为“忍受”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯忍受再忍一夜的那种吵”，此处为不定式 to bear the noise for another night。
bear 意为“忍受”，年历里 一月 那行字说明早在 1985 年之前就有人忍受过，故用过去完成时 had borne。
bear 意为“忍受”，守夜人说“忍受再忍一夜的那种吵这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 bearing the noise for another night 作主语。
bear 意为“承担”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去承担毫无怨言地担下整笔费用”，should ever 之后用原形 bear the whole cost without complaint。
bear 意为“承担”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻承担毫无怨言地担下整笔费用（bear the whole cost without complaint at once），以后再也不要提起。
bear 意为“忍受”，新来的过路人每个年头都照例承担毫无怨言地担下整笔费用，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 bears。
bear 意为“忍受”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次不图一句谢忍受再忍一夜的那种吵，用一般过去式 bore 叙述。
bear 意为“忍受”，结尾那句是母亲 1990 年的话：要忍受再忍一夜的那种吵，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和钟楼记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 bear 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1978 the keeper bore the noise for another night without a word of thanks, and nobody in the tower forgot it.
Even now the keeper bears the noise for another night at once whenever the tower asks.
Bearing the noise for another night without a word of thanks, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever bear the whole cost without complaint at once, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new traveller from the next tower bears the whole cost without complaint without a word of thanks every year, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother bore the noise for another night again, and the tower remembered that half.
